g.text: High-side, 3 shunts + P-FET range switching, logger MCU over I2C

g.desc: High-side, 3 shunts + P-FET range switching, logger MCU over I2C

g.text: Route U1 IN+ / IN- as Kelvin traces: IN+ from J1 side of R1, IN- from the J2 side of R3. Keep R3/D1/D2/Q1/Q2 area clean (leakage!).

g.desc: Route U1 IN+ / IN- as Kelvin traces: IN+ from J1 side of R1, IN- from the J2 side of R3. Keep R3/D1/D2/Q1/Q2 area clean (leakage!).

g.text: M = R1+R2+Rds(Q2) (Q2 on), H = R1+Rds(Q1) (Q1 on). Logger: CTL_x HIGH = bypass FET ON. Defaults ON at reset.

g.desc: M = R1+R2+Rds(Q2) (Q2 on), H = R1+Rds(Q1) (Q1 on). Logger: CTL_x HIGH = bypass FET ON. Defaults ON at reset.

g.text: INA228 auto-ranging current meter | ranges: L = R1+R2+R3 (~1001 ohm, both FETs off),

g.desc: INA228 auto-ranging current meter | ranges: L = R1+R2+R3 (~1001 ohm, both FETs off),

g.text: R4/R5 must go to VIN (upstream of IN+), NOT to the FET source, otherwise their current is measured. VIN max ~6V (FET Vgs).

g.desc: R4/R5 must go to VIN (upstream of IN+), NOT to the FET source, otherwise their current is measured. VIN max ~6V (FET Vgs).

g.text: Calibrate each range with a known load; zero-calibrate range L with DUT disconnected (INA bias current, FET/diode leakage).

g.desc: Calibrate each range with a known load; zero-calibrate range L with DUT disconnected (INA bias current, FET/diode leakage).
